cases.question: Print the ids and the count of passengers for all past trips
cases.reference_sql: SELECT t.trip_id, COUNT(pt.passenger_id) FROM trip t LEFT JOIN pass_in_trip pt ON t.trip_id = pt.trip_id WHERE t.time_in < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY t.trip_id;

actual.answer:
The ids and the count of passengers for all past trips are:

- Trip ID 3: 15 passengers
- Trip ID 2: 15 passengers
- Trip ID 1: 15 passengers
actual.sql: SELECT t.trip_id, COUNT(p.passenger_id) AS passenger_count FROM trip AS t LEFT JOIN pass_in_trip AS pit ON t.trip_id = pit.trip_id LEFT JOIN passenger AS p ON pit.passenger_id = p.passenger_id WHERE t.time_in IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.trip_id ORDER BY t.time_in DESC

result.sql: SELECT t.trip_id, COUNT(p.passenger_id) AS passenger_count FROM trip AS t LEFT JOIN pass_in_trip AS pit ON t.trip_id = pit.trip_id LEFT JOIN passenger AS p ON pit.passenger_id = p.passenger_id WHERE t.time_in IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.trip_id ORDER BY t.time_in DESC

cases.question: Print the names of the passengers who flew to California by Airbus A320 aircraft
cases.reference_sql: SELECT passenger_name FROM passenger Pa LEFT JOIN pass_in_trip PaTr ON Pa.passenger_id = PaTr.passenger_id LEFT JOIN trip Tr ON PaTr.trip_id = Tr.trip_id WHERE town_to = 'California' AND plane = 'Airbus A320';

actual.answer: The names of the passengers who flew to California by Airbus A320 aircraft are: Christofer, Donald, Douglas, Dwight, Earl, Edgar, Edmund, Edwin, Elliot, Eric, Ernest, James, John, Poul, Superman.
actual.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.passenger_name FROM passenger AS p JOIN pass_in_trip AS pt ON p.passenger_id = pt.passenger_id JOIN trip AS t ON pt.trip_id = t.trip_id JOIN company AS c ON t.company_id = c.company_id WHERE t.town_to = 'California' AND t.plane = 'Airbus A320'

result.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.passenger_name FROM passenger AS p JOIN pass_in_trip AS pt ON p.passenger_id = pt.passenger_id JOIN trip AS t ON pt.trip_id = t.trip_id JOIN company AS c ON t.company_id = c.company_id WHERE t.town_to = 'California' AND t.plane = 'Airbus A320'
